args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` in all three regions.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): Documented that v2.3.1 caused health check failures, that the service was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and that the on-call engineer was paged. The incident is open for follow-up monitoring.
